summary: Claude Code loaded the dispatching-parallel-agents skill as its first tool call in response to the four-independent-failures request, then dispatched parallel investigation agents.
reasoning: The single acceptance criterion is met by the authoritative session log: the dispatching-parallel-agents skill was the agent's very first tool invocation, ahead of any investigation, and it shaped the stated strategy ('one agent per domain, dispatched concurrently'). The only deviation is the plugin namespace being 'hyperpowers' rather than 'superpowers', which I flag as an observation rather than a failure since it is clearly the same skill in this build.

observations.description: Namespace mismatch vs. the story: the loaded skill is 'hyperpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents', while the acceptance criterion names 'superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents'. Same skill name, different plugin namespace — worth confirming this rename is intentional.

The prepared workdir contains none of the four test paths (only src/index.js, src/utils.js, package.json, README.md and no test runner). The agent noticed and said so, but it still dispatched four agents to investigate files that don't exist — a fixture that may not match the story's intent.
Startup required four separate confirmation prompts (theme, security notes, trust folder, bypass-permissions) before the session was usable.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents skill up front (before sequential investigation)
criteria.evidence: Session log ...coding-agent-workdir/54d009cd-9a0c-4ab3-8b33-d0f11e27b238.jsonl line 15: "name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents"}. grep -no '"name":"\(Skill\|Bash\|Task\|Agent\)"' shows 15:Skill, 19:Bash, 28:Bash — the Skill load precedes any investigation tool call. Screen confirms: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' as the first action, followed by 'the right approach is one agent per domain, dispatched concurrently' and '⏺ Agent(Investigate login redirect test)'. Note the skill namespace is 'hyperpowers:' not 'superpowers:' in this build.
